name: htop
description: Interactive process viewer for Unix systems, showing a scrollable, colorized list of processes with CPU/memory usage, load average, and support for killing/renicing without typing PIDs.
strip: find "$DESTDIR$PREFIX" -type f -exec sh -c 'file "$1" | grep -q "ELF" && strip --strip-unneeded "$1"' _ {} \; 2>/dev/null || true
